name: 2026 Garmin Run Marathon Series – Thailand Half Marathon
short_description: The 2026 Garmin Run Marathon Series – Thailand Half Marathon is on Sunday 6 December 2026 at the Ayutthaya Tourist Center in Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya, over 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km.
ai_summary: The 2026 Garmin Run Marathon Series – Thailand Half Marathon is a road race on Sunday 6 December 2026, starting from the Ayutthaya Tourist Center in Pratu Chai, Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya. It is organised by Garmin Thailand and offers 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km races, with an Elite Runner entry for 21.1 km and 10 km. The half marathon starts at 4.30am, the 10 km at 5.00am and the 5 km at 5.15am.

faqs.question: What time does the Garmin Thailand Half Marathon start?
faqs.answer: The 21.1 km starts at 4.30am, and its start block is open from 4.15am to 4.40am. The 10 km starts at 5.00am and the 5 km at 5.15am. The 21.1 km and 10 km races are chip-timed and have cut-off points.

faqs.question: How much is entry and where is race kit collection?
faqs.answer: Checkrace lists the 21.1 km at THB 1,099, the 10 km at THB 999 and the 5 km at THB 599; Elite Runner entries cost THB 1,200 and need a certified qualifying result. Race kits are collected on Saturday 5 December 2026 from 10am to 7pm at the Ayutthaya Tourist Center. Postal delivery is also available.
